pattern: wake on one sender's new messages: watch schedule with a secretRef env, not a model on a timer
experience: Requested with the command-watcher feature (fork PR): an agent should poll a script it was given without a model, wake the thread only for one person's new DMs, and pass the token through request_secret into env instead of the command.
rule: A `watch` polls a command with no model and runs `prompt` only when its output changes; pass credentials in `env` (secretRef from `request_secret`), never in `command`.

prompt: Wake this thread whenever Ana (Slack user U07ANA) DMs me. Don't spend model time checking when nothing changed. You'll need my Slack token.
notes: The output has no `id`, so a correct call names `ts` as the id path. The mock result is the summary shape for a watch task.

pattern: a plain daily task stays a fixed-time schedule
experience: Control for watch-dms-from-one-person: a recurring review at a set time must not become a command watcher.
rule: Trigger: {type:'fixed_time',timeOfDay,weekdays?} for a set time of day.
